label: 1744 Wappenkalender Erklärung der Farben as monochrome chromatic decoder
subject: issue.weigel-wappenkalender.1744

sources.citation: ULB Düsseldorf 1744 Wappenkalender, Erklärung der Farben image and immediately following armorial section

observations.value: decoder_key
monochrome engraved hatch patterns plus French/German names
decode;standardise;compress;navigate
hatch sign ↔ heraldic tincture ↔ multilingual colour name

claim_limit: Directly established for the 1744 copy. Cross-year persistence of the module is catalogued, but same physical decoder matrix and identical prose architecture across all years remain unproved.

observations.value: Tincturen mit Buchstaben ... manche Unordnung und Mißverstand
symbol_ambiguity

label: Gatterer evaluates additional heraldic hatching signs against historical armorial evidence
subject: work.gatterer-abriss-heraldik
object: Rink signs for Naturfarbe and Eisenfarbe

sources.citation: Secondary transcription attributes the passage to Gatterer, Abriß der Heraldik, Nürnberg 1774, p. 12

observations.value: Gatterer reportedly calls the Naturfarbe sign superfluous but treats the Eisenfarbe distinction as instructive because old Wappenbriefe show historical usage distinguishing iron/white/silver terminology.
decode;classify;historical_verify
graphic code is evaluated by historical source practice rather than accepted as a purely conventional notation system

claim_limit: High-value secondary lead only. Promote after direct inspection of Gatterer's printed p. 12 and associated plate figures.

label: Working cross-domain hypothesis: Gatterer deploys distinct colour regimes across historical sciences
subject: agent.johann-christoph-gatterer

observations.value: Do these different colour practices share an actor-level concept of difference, comparison, Übersicht, Zeichen or Evidenz, or are they historically independent techniques gathered only by modern analysis?

claim_limit: Do not promote to a unified Gattererian colour method until shared vocabulary, cross-reference or practical transfer is directly documented.
